_about: Style registry for the four workflows, from atlas/ALIEN.md section 8. A run never repeats any of its workflow's last three styles (ledger.json). Concept ids (L1, C1, ...) are ALIEN.md section 4. pace is cuts per 10 s. needs: what the source must have for the style to work; the ideas stage only offers a style to a moment that has it.

styles.name: The Room Listens
styles.look: The real talking head stays full frame, and the room responds to the voice.
styles.hook: One word lands and lights his face.
styles.close: The payoff line, then the end card.
styles.needs: one speaker carrying the moment on camera

styles.name: Past Self
styles.look: The speaker meets an earlier version of himself from the same conversation.
styles.hook: He said the opposite earlier in this conversation.
styles.close: Both selves in frame, one line each.
styles.needs: a callback or a change of position inside the same source

styles.name: Second Camera
styles.look: A one-camera podcast edited as a three-camera show, cuts on stress and blinks.
styles.hook: An angle that should not exist.
styles.close: Pull back to the true single frame.
styles.needs: a locked-off single camera on one speaker

styles.name: Two Mouths
styles.look: Each speaker owns a lane; interruptions are physical.
styles.close: Both faces woven into one frame.
styles.needs: two people disagreeing or cutting in on each other

styles.name: Lit by the Voice
styles.look: A single quotable line, 20-40 s, near black; the face appears with the sound.
styles.hook: Black, one word, his face appears with the sound.
styles.close: The voice stops, the frame goes dark, end card.
styles.needs: one quotable line or thought of 20-40 s

styles.name: Receipts
styles.look: Bold claims with footnotes, the pitch trace and arrows to the evidence.
styles.close: The footnotes stack up as the conclusion.
styles.needs: concrete claims, numbers or names that can be footnoted

styles.name: Reading Wipe Before/After
styles.cta: the last word of the line is the keyword

styles.name: One Clip, Three Films
styles.cta: Send me your clip, or a keyword

styles.name: Silent Film, Hidden Word
styles.cta: Pause-Proof Keyword in the last 3 s
